title: Set 1: Entrepreneurial Competencies & Mindset
description: Match each competency or concept with its foundational definition based on the module.

pairs.right: Intellectually disciplined process of conceptualizing, analyzing, and evaluating data
pairs.explanation: Disciplined evaluation of facts and risks to guide rational decisions.

pairs.right: Ability to adjust rapidly to changes in market dynamics, technology, and business environment
pairs.explanation: Pivoting strategies quickly when industry conditions or consumer demands evolve.

pairs.right: Identifying customer pain points and market gaps and turning them into viable ventures
pairs.explanation: The ability to spot business solutions within everyday consumer challenges.

pairs.right: Bouncing back swiftly from failures, setbacks, and challenges as learning opportunities
pairs.explanation: Recovering emotionally and operationally from business adversity.

pairs.right: Making effective use of available resources and discovering creative alternatives
pairs.explanation: Achieving maximum results with minimal inputs when resources are tight.

title: Set 2: Business Plan & Business Start-up Structures
description: Match each business structure or plan component with its key legal attribute or definition.

pairs.right: Owned by one individual; offers full control but entails Unlimited Liability
pairs.explanation: Simple to launch via DTI, but personal assets can be seized for company debts.

pairs.right: Owned by 2+ individuals; pooled capital and skills but has Limited Life
pairs.explanation: Dissolves automatically upon the withdrawal, insolvency, or death of a partner.

pairs.right: Separate juridical entity featuring Limited Liability and Perpetual Existence
pairs.explanation: Owned by shareholders and legally registered through the SEC.

pairs.right: High-level overview synthesizing the core goals and strategies of the business plan
pairs.explanation: Section II of the business plan providing an executive briefing.

pairs.right: Itemized schedule of materials detailing description, quantity, unit cost, and total cost
pairs.explanation: Section IV(b) table establishing production capital needs.

title: Set 3: Permits, Licenses & Registration Agencies
description: Match each government office or permit with its statutory role in business registration.

pairs.right: Issues the Business Name Registration Certificate for Sole Proprietorships
pairs.explanation: National registry for sole proprietorship business names.

pairs.right: Registers, incorporates, and regulates Partnerships and Corporations
pairs.explanation: Confers legal personality to corporate and partnership entities.

pairs.right: Issues TIN, Certificate of Registration (Form 2303), and ATP for Official Receipts
pairs.explanation: National tax authority governing taxation and legal accounting books.

pairs.right: Initial local community permit required before applying for a Mayor's Permit
pairs.explanation: Secured from the local barangay hall where the premises are situated.

pairs.right: Safety clearance issued by the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP)
pairs.explanation: Mandatory clearance verifying compliance with National Fire Code standards.

title: Set 4: Forms & Concepts of Social Entrepreneurship
description: Match each social entrepreneurship model or concept with its defining characteristic.

pairs.right: Small-scale local effort addressing neighborhood issues (e.g., community gardens)
pairs.explanation: Grassroots projects serving localized social or environmental needs.

pairs.right: Reinvests surplus revenue into its endowment/mission rather than paying shareholders
pairs.explanation: Mission-driven entity bound by law to dedicate income to its cause.

pairs.right: Autonomous, member-owned association democratically meeting common needs
pairs.explanation: Jointly owned enterprise governed under ICA cooperative principles.

pairs.right: Generates commercial profit while affecting positive public change (impact investing)
pairs.explanation: Strikes an ideal balance between profitability and societal progress.

pairs.right: Translating feelings of grief, sympathy, and despair into concrete ethical action
pairs.explanation: Guiding moral philosophy behind impactful social ventures.
